title: About TNI²TRI
subtitle: An Intelligence-to-Transformation System for Industries
intro: TNI²TRI 2026 is designed to help industries understand their current state, determine transformation readiness, identify priorities and move toward structured transformation.

systemConnection.headline: The system connects:
systemConnection.chain: Industrial Intelligence → Transformation Readiness → Transformation Intelligence & Implementation

purpose.title: Our Purpose
purpose.headline: Transformation should be based on understanding.
purpose.description:
TNI²TRI exists to create a structured bridge between:

What is happening
and
What should happen next.
purpose.detailedDescription: It brings intelligence, assessment, evidence, diagnosis, readiness, prioritisation, resources, planning, transformation, measurement and learning into one connected cycle.

coreQuestions.title: Our Core Questions
coreQuestions.intro: TNI²TRI is built around three fundamental questions:

questions.question: What is happening?
questions.description: Establishes contextual visibility into sector dynamics, technology evolution, benchmark metrics, competitive movements, and macro environment signals.

questions.question: Where are we now, and what are we ready for?
questions.description: Rigorous, multi-domain assessment evaluating capability maturity, factual evidence, hidden dependencies, vulnerabilities, and organizational readiness.

questions.question: What should we do next, and how should we transform?
questions.description: Translates diagnostic clarity into prioritized sequencing, resource deployment, structured execution, change governance, and iterative reassessment.

philosophy.title: Our Philosophy
philosophy.headline: Understand Before You Transform.
philosophy.statement: Transformation without sufficient understanding can create:

pitfalls.title: Misaligned investment
pitfalls.desc: Capital deployed into tools, technologies, or programs that fail to address the core bottleneck.

pitfalls.title: Fragmented initiatives
pitfalls.desc: Siloed efforts across departments lacking unified architectural vision and coordination.

pitfalls.title: Unnecessary complexity
pitfalls.desc: Over-engineered systems that overburden teams rather than streamlining industrial flow.

pitfalls.title: Poor resource allocation
pitfalls.desc: Misdirected human, financial, and management attention starving critical high-leverage domains.

pitfalls.title: Weak adoption
pitfalls.desc: Employee resistance and procedural bypasses resulting from unprepared cultural and skills baselines.

pitfalls.title: Unmeasured outcomes
pitfalls.desc: Vague objectives that cannot be corroborated with empirical evidence or repeatable KPIs.

philosophy.conclusion: TNI²TRI therefore establishes understanding before recommending transformation direction.

continuousModel.title: Our Continuous Model
continuousModel.subtitle: An unbroken feedback loop for sustainable industrial leadership

stages.name: INTELLIGENCE
stages.desc: Continuous environmental and internal data gathering

stages.name: READINESS
stages.desc: Diagnostic capability profiling and gap validation

stages.name: TRANSFORMATION
stages.desc: Disciplined roadmap execution and capability building

stages.name: IMPACT
stages.desc: Empirical measurement of operational and economic value

stages.name: LEARNING
stages.desc: Institutional knowledge codification and insight capture

stages.name: REASSESSMENT
stages.desc: Periodic diagnostic calibration of the new organizational state

stages.name: RENEWAL
stages.desc: Strategic horizon scanning and next-phase capability renewal
